name: Rushmark
summary:
Rushmark is a competitive 2D speedrunning platformer in which every course, every Marathon and Survival has its own online leaderboard. Every personal best goes on the board, and players can pull any entry off it to race that player's recorded run as a ghost, or watch it to see how the course was beaten. A season ranking scores players across every board, so losing a single course to another player costs season standing, and each season pays out cosmetic skins that are never awarded again once it closes.

The courses are short and fixed, cleared in under thirty seconds once learned, and set in a cyberpunk underworld. There is no health bar: touching a hazard ends the attempt, and a restart is instant. The move set is run, jump, an eight-way dash, a wall kick and an area burst. The dash is also the main attack: on the ground it recharges after a short cooldown, but in the air the player gets only one, and dashing through an enemy restores it. The game has ten timed courses, an endless Survival mode that speeds up the longer a run lasts, and three Marathons that chain courses back to back.
